clinical_guidelines: American College of Cardiology (ACC) and American Heart Association (AHA) guidelines for management of adults with congenital heart disease (ACHD) have been updated multiple times.
Therapeutic guidelines focus on exercise intolerance, cardiopulmonary exercise testing, ventilatory efficiency, and implantation of cardioverter-defibrillators in specific conditions.
Prognostic factors such as anemia, hyponatremia, and cardiopulmonary response predict outcomes in adults with congenital heart disease.
